page.layout: Full-width title block at top, below a woodcut ornament (not transcribed). Below a rule, one text column of dedication with a large woodcut initial D. Right margin is empty. Foot: signature and catchword.

main_text.l: quæ me ad hoc pensum subeun-
quod nullum viderim Latinè saltem, hanc
Note: printed in a mix of roman, italic and black capitals; italic and roman distinctions in the dedication body are approximate.

page.notes: Long s is written as s throughout. Printed "VIC-" and "VI" ligature in the title is read as INVIC-. Initial D is a large woodcut letter joined to "uo", giving "Duo". The v of "controuersiam" is printed as u in the scan and is normalised to controversiam per the u/v rule. The page number is not printed. No running head. Italic/roman boundaries in the dedication body are approximate. Left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
